# GTA 6 Countdown

> Independent fan-made GTA VI information hub and live countdown to November 19, 2026.

Canonical site: https://mnakrani245.github.io/gta-vi/
Last reviewed: 2026-07-11
Language: English

## Important pages

- [Live GTA 6 Countdown](https://mnakrani245.github.io/gta-vi/): Live local-time countdown, confirmed launch facts, trailers, imagery and FAQs.
- [GTA 6 Release Date](https://mnakrani245.github.io/gta-vi/release-date.html): Direct answer about the November 19, 2026 release date and announced platforms.
- [GTA 6 Trailers](https://mnakrani245.github.io/gta-vi/trailers.html): Official Trailer 1 and Trailer 2 guide.
- [GTA 6 Characters](https://mnakrani245.github.io/gta-vi/characters.html): Confirmed character guide for Jason, Lucia and supporting characters.
- [GTA 6 Locations](https://mnakrani245.github.io/gta-vi/locations.html): Confirmed Vice City and Leonida destination guide.
- [About and Editorial Policy](https://mnakrani245.github.io/gta-vi/about.html): Site identity, sourcing, correction policy and trademark disclaimer.

## Source and attribution policy

Confirmed game facts are checked against Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive materials. The site distinguishes official information from speculation and does not claim affiliation with Rockstar Games. Grand Theft Auto, GTA VI and related media are property of Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive.

Primary official source: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI
